title: Sweetwater Grade 2 lesson plan, week of Nov 30
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson #/Title] Magnetic Foundational Skills - Unit 3: Sessions 6-10 Heggerty - Week 15
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Vocabulary & Strategy] Super Words: know, new, over, people
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Monday (session 6), Learning Target] Today I will read and write words with the long o sound and read longer words and super words.
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Monday (session 6), Success Criteria] recognize the long o sound in words spelled o and oa.
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Monday (session 6), Success Criteria] read the super words know, new, over, and people.
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Wednesday (session 8), Success Criteria] recognize the long o sound spelled ow and oe.
[Phonics 11/30 - 12/4, Wednesday (session 8), Success Criteria] read and write words with the long o sound using ow and oe.
[Reading 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson #/Title] Magnetic Integrated Literacy - Unit 3, Sessions 6-10
[Reading 11/30 - 12/4, Vocabulary & Strategy] Unit Words - shelter, shady, valley, burrowing, nonliving, nectar, protect
[Reading 11/30 - 12/4, Wednesday (session 8), Learning Target] Today I will work with others to research deserts and create a visitor's guidebook.
[Grammar 11/30 - 12/4, Thursday (session 9), Learning Target] Today I will identify articles in sentences.
[Writing 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson #/Title] Unit 3: Desert Habitat Survival
[Writing 11/30 - 12/4, Monday, Learning Target] Today I will compare a fictional text with an informational text about the desert.
[Writing 11/30 - 12/4, Wednesday, I do] Review irregular verbs such as grew, dug, hid, and fled.
[Writing 11/30 - 12/4, Wednesday, We do] dig → dug
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson #/Title] Unit 2: Numbers Within 100: Addition, Subtraction, Time, and Money Lesson 6-11 Review
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Whole Group Instruction, Monday] Monday: Lesson 6 (Add Two-Digit Numbers) & Lesson 7 (Subtract Two-Digit Numbers) review
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Whole Group Instruction, Tuesday] Tuesday: Lesson 10 (Solving Word Problems Involving Money) review
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Whole Group Instruction, Wednesday] Wednesday: Lesson 11 (Tell and Write Time) review
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Success Criteria] find how many minutes passed between a start and end time.
[Math 11/30 - 12/4, Whole Group Instruction, Thursday] Thursday: Lessons 6-11 Review Unit Assessment
[SS 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson #/Title] Unit 3: Georgia’s First People (Muscogee Creek people)
[SS 11/30 - 12/4, Monday, I Do] Introduce Indigenous people and explain that the Muscogee and Cherokee lived in the area now called Georgia long before it became a state.
[SS 11/30 - 12/4, Thursday, Lesson] Muscogee (Creek) people food, tools, and ways of making a living
[SS 11/30 - 12/4, Thursday, I Do] Explain farming, hunting, fishing, gathering, and trading. Introduce corn, beans, and squash.
[SS 11/30 - 12/4, Lesson Link label] Lesson Link: 2nd Science/Social Studies Pacing Support
